title: Evidence list can answer which references decisions and meetings and approvals really cite
hosted_verification_note: No VM or SSH access performed; functional evidence only, using recorded owner shapes and the hosted reference ids the coordinator measured on 2026-11-25. Hosted verification belongs to the operator acceptance task.

coordinator_decisions_applied.research_ticket_fields: Acceptance 2 'research tickets results' means the recorded submission evidence_refs and human_input.evidence_refs (services/research/write_owner.py); the ticket page projection returns both.
coordinator_decisions_applied.meeting_positions: Option (a): positions are read from meeting detail, capped at the 30 newest meetings, details read in overlap through the owner-read executor pattern (submit_owner_read, a 4-worker pool so at most 4 in flight), caller identity and tenant kept (MeetingsOwnerClient(tenant, actor)), read/truncated/failed counts reported, one failed detail marks the source partial. The one-call-per-source rule is relaxed for this source only.
coordinator_decisions_applied.reference_shapes: artifact-persona-paper-*, facts:registry_entry:*, facts:strategy_pool:<persona>@<v>, facts:member_virtual_book:*, facts:meeting_topic:* (the meeting itself, not listed), evidence:search_excerpt:ko-evi-* (knowledge object; resolved to evi-<x> only when sha256('evi-<x>')[:12] equals the ko suffix, through the existing owner item read, for the visible page only). Verified: sha256('evi-1217cd1c8ccc7274')[:12] == '94a73ebc0814'.
coordinator_decisions_applied.supplied_only: Case-file items that were only supplied are never listed: only citations fields are read.

acceptance_as_delivered: 1. GET /bff/management/evidence?scope=cited returns one row per cited reference with ref_id, ref_kind, source_owner, label (+name_missing), source_class, resolved_link and cited_by entries {entity_type, entity_ref, label, parts, route_href, time}. Without scope (or scope=ingested) the answer is the unchanged ingested list; a ref_id lookup resolves an ingested item in every scope (scope=cited + ref_id uses the existing path).

2. Citations come only from recorded fields through existing owner reads: meeting proposals citations; meeting positions citations (rounds[].positions[].citations from meeting detail, 30 newest meetings); governance approvals evidence_refs; evolution proposals evidence_refs; research demands retrieval_influence.metadata.cited_item_ids; research tickets submission evidence_refs and human_input.evidence_refs; persona daily cycle decisions cited_case_file_item_ids. A reference only supplied in a case file is not listed; a facts:meeting_topic reference is the meeting itself and is not listed.

3. Each source has status (ok|partial|failed|denied), reason, read_count, truncated, failed_count, citation_count, withheld_count, calls and response_bytes; a failed or denied source is shown and the total is marked incomplete; a viewer denied approvals still gets the other sources; when every source fails the answer is unavailable with total null, never an empty ok list.

4. Private persona memory and trader items and other-tenant rows are never returned (meetings withholding rule in its strictest form, project_case_file with no private persona, reference kind memory_persona_private); memory fails closed: any memory reference (lessons:*, *:memory_*:*, bare mem-*, owner ref kind naming memory) is withheld and counted unless its recorded case-file item carries relevance_scope persona_and_committee; redact_evidence_refs is reused fail-closed. Tests prove a private memory reference is dropped from meetings, demands and cycle decisions, and a bare mem-... reference is dropped from a proposal, a meeting position, a persona cycle decision, a demand and an approval.

5. Reads are bounded: one owner call per source except meeting positions (1 list + at most 30 details, 4 in flight, per coordinator decision); at most 500 references; at most 20 item reads for the visible page; no new store, writer, index or cross-request cache. Cost per request is in meta.cost and below.

6. Labels are names only from the existing DisplayNameResolver (strategy label for registry artifacts and virtual books, persona name for strategy pools, meeting topic with persona ids replaced via present_title, recorded titles for proposals/approvals/evolution/tickets, else null); structured parts (label_parts on rows; cited_by[].parts with meeting name, round, position, kind, persona) are sent for frontend translation and the BFF composes no sentences; an unnamed id keeps label=ref_id and name_missing=true; links point only at management pages that exist in frontend src/App.tsx (strategies/:id, personas/:id, meetings/:id, evidence/:id, approvals, evolution-journal); memory, research note, committee memo, research ticket and unresolved knowledge-object references answer null because no page renders one entry.

7. Tests use recorded shapes from meetings (Consultation detail and proposals), approvals (Governance evidence_refs {ref_type, ref_id}), research tickets and demands, and OODA cycle packets (persona_cycle.case_files + decisions); BFF_API_CONTRACT.md documents the scope; no existing test was weakened or deleted; assertions changed inside this task's own new test file are listed under justified_changed_assertions.

cost_per_request.formula: owner_calls = 6 (one per non-position source) + 1 (meeting list) + min(meetings, 30) detail reads + at most 20 item reads for the visible page
cost_per_request.hosted_projection_from_coordinator_measu: 20 meetings: 20 details = 495 KB and 6.2 s sequential (~0.31 s each). With 4 in flight that is about 5 waves x 0.31 s = ~1.6 s and ~0.5 MB for the positions source; at the cap of 30 meetings about 8 waves = ~2.5 s and ~0.75 MB. Other sources are single list reads in parallel. Route budget 8.0 s; a source not done 0.25 s before the deadline is reported failed(read_timeout) and the rest is still returned.

residual_findings: tests/bff_test_architecture_inventory.json was not updated: it already omits ~98 newer test files and its test does not require registration; registering only this file would be inconsistent.
Meeting details share one 4-worker pool per process, so concurrent cited requests queue their detail reads; per request at most 4 are in flight.
Pre-existing failures noted above (control_loops OODA redaction count, ranking surfaces ordering, mgmt_load_005 timing, persona fleet registry contract) are untouched.
Telemetry-summary and other non-directory references have no name directory; they answer name_missing=true until an owner exposes names.

Memory, research-note, committee-memo and research-ticket references link nowhere (null) until a management page renders a single entry; the approvals and evolution-journal links open the list pages without focusing the row because those pages read no decision id parameter.
